products.name: Oracle C2M Hypercare & Production Support Runbook (Go-Live Readiness) — Commercial
products.short_description: The C2M hypercare and production-support runbook — go-live readiness, on-call/escalation, incident handling, day-2 support, and health routine — so the team runs production confidently from cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Go live on C2M — and survive hypercare with a runbook

The riskiest weeks of any C2M program are go-live and hypercare. This solution provides the hypercare and production-support runbook: go-live readiness checks, the on-call and escalation model, incident and known-issue handling, day-2 build support in lower environments, and the monitoring/health routine — so the team runs production confidently from cutover through stabilization.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the hypercare operating model (readiness → cutover → hypercare → steady-state) and the production-support structure.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (monitoring, on-call rota, escalation contacts, runbook access, lower-environment access for day-2).
  • Runbook — go-live readiness checklist, on-call/escalation model, incident + known-issue handling, day-2 build support in lower environments, and the daily health/monitoring routine, with gates.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (readiness met, incidents handled, health stable) plus Best Practices for a smooth stabilization.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A C2M go-live and hypercare the team can actually run — readiness proven, on-call structured, incidents handled, health stable — from cutover through stabilization.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 6 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MHYPER-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of C2M go-live readiness and health current state
    • OC2MHYPER-Remediation.sh — align safe operational hypercare settings to the standard (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MHYPER-Report.sh — read-only daily health snapshot and open-incident / known-issue summary
    • OC2MHYPER-Report.sql — read-only batch, integration, and database health detail from the C2M schema
    • OC2MHYPER-ScopeHelper.sh — render the on-call rota window and the day-2 build lane from the scope file
    • OC2MHYPER-Validation.sh — read-only validation of the technical go-live readiness signals

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
